title: A map of stalks of coherent modules comes from a map on a neighbourhood
statement: Let $X$ be a locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth], $\mathcal F,\mathcal G$ coherent $\mathcal O_X$-modules [pqf-def-coherent], $x\in X$, and $\psi:\mathcal G_x\to\mathcal F_x$ a homomorphism of $\mathcal O_{X,x}$-modules (stalks as in [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]). Then there are an open neighbourhood $U$ of $x$ and a homomorphism of $\mathcal O_U$-modules $\varphi:\mathcal G|_U\to\mathcal F|_U$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] (restrictions $\mathcal F|_U(V)=\mathcal F(V)$ for $V\subseteq U$ open) whose stalk map at $x$ is $\varphi_x=\psi$.
